whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body: Achieving Community Tasks Successfully (ACTS) is a nonprofit organization that provides information, resources, and training to empower communities in reaching their sustainability goals and objectives. ACTS focuses its efforts on the near-port Eastside Houston communities of Pleasantville, Clinton Park, and Port Houston.

whatWeDo.heading: What We Do
whatWeDo.body: ACTS is a community-based organization dedicated to advancing environmental justice, public health, and disaster resilience through education, training, and community engagement. ACTS works at the intersection of science and community by translating complex issues into practical, actionable solutions that empower residents and organizations.

pillars.label: Education
pillars.description: Translating complex environmental and health issues into clear, practical knowledge.

pillars.label: Engagement
pillars.description: Bringing residents and organizations together around shared community goals.

pillars.label: Action
pillars.description: Turning knowledge into actionable solutions residents can put to work.

whyWeExist.heading: CLOSING THE GAP BETWEEN KNOWLEDGE AND ACTION.
whyWeExist.body: ACTS exists to close the gap between knowledge and action. Too often, communities most affected by environmental hazards, health disparities, and disasters lack access to the tools, resources, and support needed to respond effectively. We do this work to ensure that all communities are equipped, informed, and empowered to protect themselves and thrive.
